title: WATCH reaches live spectator surface with correct permission boundaries
preconditions: Spectator surface is enabled on the reference deployment
At least one agent is registered for Agent POV tests
Public spectator policy is configured for the local environment

steps.notes: WATCH can reach live spectator surface
Public observer cannot access restricted data
Agent POV matches agent observation boundary
Spectator narrative output cannot mutate world truth
Authorized research observer uses consent-partitioned surfaces only

assertions: WATCH can reach live spectator surface
Public observer cannot access restricted data
Agent POV matches agent observation boundary exactly
Spectator narrative output cannot mutate world truth
Spectator projections and summaries are never world truth
Authenticated and research observers remain non-authoritative for world state
